native_servers.execution: Fresh native NeoForge GameTest servers, development runtime using compiled production source and final resources; installable JAR classes/resources checked byte for byte during packaging.

client.runtime: ordinary NeoForge Minecraft client, software Mesa and null OpenAL output
client.scope: Visual pass used the release production code, models and textures. Final food-tag membership was subsequently refreshed from the independent generator output and reloaded in both final native server profiles.

targeted_regressions: Old fruit/seed NBT resolves to garden variants with stack count and custom components intact.
Old orchard palettes preserve pod age/facing, expanded crown and seedling stage.
Removed IDs are aliases, not duplicate registry entries or market catalog entries.
Actual held-item meals shift child affinity once, after eating; core cases cover both food profiles, adult locking and bounds.
All land cells directly adjacent to Hero pool water have full marble collision; deliberately restored screenshot gaps are repaired.
Nine Neutral plants are dry, supported and collision-free; source-water cascades and pale ledges remain intact.
limits: The garden remains a Minecraft reconstruction, with earlier user-requested layout adaptations preserved.
Reference review used five retained native Battle-video frames and the supplied Hero gap screenshot, not a new complete source-game walkthrough.
Neutral scenic water color also applies to kindergarten decorative water through the shared biome.
Internal client frames and disposable worlds are excluded from the package.
Audio features are unchanged; no new original-recording authenticity or listening test is claimed.
